title: Clumped-Variants (dev)
bodyHtml:
Linkage disequilibrium (LD) clumping reports the most significant genetic associations in a region in terms of a smaller number of "clumps" of genetically linked SNPs. This can help the researcher to assess how many independent loci are associated with a given trait. For more details on LD clumping, please see this page.

The variants in the clump you have selected are displayed on this page. Enter criteria into any of the filters below to filter both the plot and the table. Click on any column header to sort the table by that column.
